chunks: Abu Nasr Muhammad ibn al-Husayn al-Basir al-Muqri informed me, from Abu Abdillah al-Asadi, from Ja'far ibn Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Alawi al-Muhammadi, from Yahya ibn Hashim al-Ghassani, from Ghayath ibn Ibrahim, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both), from his father, from his grandfather, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:

"I was taught the seven oft-repeated verses (Surah al-Fatiha), and my entire nation was presented before me in clay form, until I could see its small and its great. And I looked throughout all the heavens. And when I saw — I saw you, O Ali — so I sought forgiveness for you and for your followers until the Day of Resurrection."
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about seeking forgiveness for Ali and his followers?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) describes being granted the seven oft-repeated verses (Surah al-Fatiha, cf. Quran 15:87) and being shown his entire nation in primordial clay form. Upon seeing Ali among them, he sought divine forgiveness for Ali and all his followers (Shi'ah) until the Day of Judgment. This narration highlights Ali's special status in the Prophet's vision and the prophetic intercession for the Shi'ah community.
